optimizedDescription.value: Defines specd-project-context-optimizer and specd-spec-context-optimizer; gate on project status llmOptimizedContext.

optimizedContext.value:
# skills:agents

## Rules
- Provide specialized optimizer agents: `specd-project-context-optimizer` (project context) and `specd-spec-context-optimizer` (spec metadata).
- Skills bundle MUST NOT publish standard `specd-metadata` skill. Metadata optimization via specialized agents only.
- Prompts MUST use smart caveman style: drop articles/filler, use fragments, preserve technical exactness (symbols, APIs, values, constants), maintain Markdown headings (`## Rules`, `## Constraints`).
- Target 50-70% token reduction vs full spec/metadata without normative loss.
- Agent templates (e.g. `SPECD-AGENT.md.tpl`) MUST contain ONLY raw prompt/instructions — NO YAML frontmatter/metadata. Place metadata in `specd-agent.meta.json`.
- Missing `agents` capability fallback: copy template file to directory of `shared.md` for orchestrator inspection/execution.
- `llmOptimizedContext` gate: run `specd project status --format toon` and read top-level `llmOptimizedContext`. MUST NOT use `specd specs metadata` as enablement gate (that is materialized spec projection, not effective project config). If field not exactly `true`, MUST exit without generating/persisting any optimized field, metadata document, or lock state.
- Spec optimizer persist: `specd specs optimizations set <spec-id> --optimized-description <text> --optimized-context <text>` (`cli:spec-optimizations`). MAY omit one direct option. MUST NOT combine either direct option with `--input`.
- Project optimizer persist: `specd project update-metadata --optimized-context <text>`. MUST NOT route project context through spec-scoped optimizations command.
- Spec optimizer MUST NOT use metadata editors (`update-metadata`/`write-metadata`/equivalent) for spec-level optimized content. MUST NOT run `specd specs generate-metadata` after persist — consumers self-heal.
